mechanism.summary: Store each resolved public instance-field string key once as a shared runtime key, then install a new default data property through one ordinary-object borrow when the receiver remains extensible, non-exotic, and has no own property at that key.
mechanism.generality: The fast path is selected only by the class field's already-resolved string key and the receiver's live ordinary-object state. It does not inspect workload names, source paths, function identities, input values, iteration counts, or expected results. Symbols, proxies, non-object receivers, TypedArrays, module namespaces, non-extensible objects, existing own properties, and every unsupported condition retain the complete generic path.
semantic_risks: preserving field initializer order and the absence of each field until its own initializer has completed
falling back before any mutation when an earlier initializer, a superclass return value, or a host object has made the receiver non-extensible, exotic, or already owns the field key
preserving CreateDataPropertyOrThrow descriptor attributes and TypeError behavior on every declined receiver
mirroring a successful definition on a realm global through the existing realm-global synchronization hook

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-28 /tmp/qjs-readcache-ray.x9bVqm/raytrace.sample; current main executable SHA-256 70208d9c129430c98e186956b01f0384eb6525aaa8f30e8fe02a9551a7f9b45c; wrapper SHA-256 824daa5582289787f6e25a200892a1d6bdfa682afe9ce76a30e520dc7e03528c. Of 1,550 main-thread samples, the class-field path retains 117 initialize_instance_fields frames, 78 define_property_on_value_key frames, 60 ObjectRef::define_property frames, and 20 PropertyStorage::insert frames. The independent source declares many public fields on repeatedly constructed Color, Vector, Ray, Material, Shape, and derived instances.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Every ordinary instance field clones its stored String key, builds a default descriptor, enters generic property-definition dispatch, probes the receiver more than once, and copies the key into ordinary storage. Sharing the resolved key and combining the ordinary absent-property check with insertion removes those repeated allocation and dispatch costs while leaving all semantic exceptions on the generic path.
